description: Turn a list of business email addresses into the company domains behind them, for matching leads and contacts to accounts in a CRM. Send up to 200 addresses. Get back each domain with how many distinct addresses use it, which domains are free-mail providers (gmail.com, outlook.com ...), the role addresses (info@, sales@, support@ ...), how many entries were exact duplicates, and the position of every entry that is not a valid address. A person's address is counted but never echoed back; nothing is stored. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/email-domain-extract). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.
